# Equation of state and thermodynamic functions {#sec-ch03}

This chapter describes how kintera relates temperature, pressure, density and composition, and how it computes
the internal energy, enthalpy, entropy and heat capacity of a mixture of gases and condensates. Every other part
of the library that needs a thermodynamic state reads it through the functions described here: the saturation
adjustment of @sec-ch04, the kinetics of @sec-ch06 and the coupling of @sec-ch14.

| scheme | YAML key or option | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch03-eos | `compute` (API) | always | exact | `test_thermo` |
| @sec-ch03-species-functions | `cv_R`[^rg-4630a13a9883], `u0_R`[^rg-5d6bd36f1041], `s0_R` | 5/2, 0, 0 | exact; condensate entropy needs a full-rank nucleation block | `test_nasa9_cp.py` |
| @sec-ch03-reference-state | `reference-state`[^rg-5d34b8be2a13] | 300 K, $10^5$ Pa | exact | `test_reference_state_keys.py` |
| @sec-ch03-thermo-y | `ThermoY` (API) | caller | exact | `test_thermo` |
| @sec-ch03-thermo-x | `ThermoX` (API) | caller | exact; `PXS->T` can be wrong (Limits) | `test_thermo` |
| @sec-ch03-relative-humidity | `relative_humidity` (API) | caller | exact | `test_inline_svp.py` |
| @sec-ch03-adiabat | `extrapolate_dlnp`, `extrapolate_dz` (API) | caller | reversible: $\bar s$ held exactly in $\ln p$; `rainout`: first in $\ln p$ (review measurement); second in $z$ (not measured) | `test_thermo` |

: Schemes of the thermodynamics chapter. "Order" is the order of the scheme's discretization; a function
evaluated pointwise is exact. {#tbl-ch03-schemes}

[^rg-4630a13a9883]: cv_R — reference heat capacity at constant volume divided by the gas constant; default 5/2; stored in `species_cref_R`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L172-L176)

[^rg-5d6bd36f1041]: u0_R — reference internal energy divided by the gas constant, in K; default 0; stored in `species_uref_R`; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/0d9f67f97d841147e23283d2dcdab302238d2c45/src/species.cpp#L178-L182)
